title: Business English Conversation 14:  Frequent Flier Miles
content: 1. a travel coordinator: a person who makes travel plans for workers at a company - We travel a lot on business, so our company has a travel coordinator. - The travel coordinator has a stressful job at our company. 2. to not be signed up for frequent flier miles: to not be a member of an airline's reward program - I am not signed up for frequent flier miles because I don't travel a lot. - She travels a lot, but she is not signed up for frequent flier miles. 3. at the end of the week: Thursday or Friday - We have a meeting at the end of the week. - We get paid at the end of the week.
